_meta.source_of_truth: es-starter ChangeLogDocument — the storage DTO actually indexed; field types mirror it
_meta.why: dynamic:false is what stops mapping explosion: if the index does not exist, ES auto-creates it with dynamic mapping on the first write, turns every changed field of every model into an ES field, and hits index.mapping.total_fields.limit (default 1000) — after which writes are rejected and the only fix is a reindex. dataBeforeChange/dataAfterChange are JSON strings (ChangeLogDocument flattens the payload maps), so keyword + index:false + doc_values:false keeps them as unindexed _source-only scalars and fails fast at write time if a producer ever regresses to sending objects.
_meta.note: _meta must live INSIDE mappings — at the top level the create-index API rejects it with 400 'unknown key [_meta]'.
